title: Platform Engineer
description:
Role: Platform Software Engineer

At Everest, our Platform team builds the core framework that enables fast and consistent business application development. As part of this team, you'll help shape the Everest platform—a flexible and evolving foundation used across the company to deliver high-quality features to our customers. We focus heavily on improving the developer experience, building the tooling, abstractions, and infrastructure that empower teams to move faster with confidence.

You'll join a multidisciplinary team spread across Brazil and Germany, tackling a wide range of engineering challenges: API design and handling, backend/frontend communication, status and draft management, process modeling, translation support, performance optimizations, developer tooling, among others. If you thrive on technical variety, enjoy building foundational systems used by many, and want to create tools that elevate how developers build software, we'd love to hear from you.

Hybrid working policy with three days on site in our Porto Alegre office.

What you get to do

  • Work with an incredible team of world-class engineers to build and evolve the core framework that powers application development across the Everest ERP platform.
  • Develop the foundational tooling, abstractions, and infrastructure that enable developers to build and ship high-quality features quickly and consistently.
  • Design and maintain platform-level capabilities such as API design and handling, backend/frontend communication, status and draft management, and process modeling.
  • Optimize performance and build developer-centric tooling that enhances velocity and confidence.
  • Collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team of 6 engineers (3 in Germany, 3 in Brazil) on feature development, scalability, and architecture decisions.
  • Help define and refine the internal developer experience by identifying friction points and building elegant solutions.
  • Work closely with Product Managers and application developers to plan and deliver on impactful platform initiatives.

What you need

  • A passion for building tools and systems that empower other engineers.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and fluency in TypeScript.
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to work with teammates across time zones.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills across the stack.
  • Experience designing APIs, managing state and data lifecycles, or developing internal tools.
  • Comfort working on both frontend and backend systems.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, especially in remote and asynchronous settings.
  • Experience with modern development workflows and version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with performance profiling, scalability concerns, and developer tooling best practices is a plus.
  • Bonus: experience with internationalization, process modeling, or status/draft systems.

What you've already done

  • 2+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, ideally building platform-level features or tools.
  • Built or contributed to systems that serve other developers, such as frameworks, internal SDKs, or dev tooling.
  • Worked in an agile, remote-first team environment.
  • Shipped production software in a modern web stack.
  • Experience in early-stage or startup environments is a plus.
  • ERP experience is beneficial, but not required.

title: Executive Assistant to VP of Engineering (ConnectWise)
description:
We are looking for an Executive Assistant to VP of Engineering to work alongside the VP of Engineering and develop data-driven decision-making processes for the engineering, product, and operations teams.

You will build and maintain metrics, dashboards, and KPI frameworks, turning complex data into clear insights that will guide strategic planning.

This position focuses on analytics, reporting, and collaborating with stakeholder, rather than on direct project delivery.

You'll have a strong influence on executive-level decisions, gain exposure to cross-functional teams, and help evolve data measurement and observability practices across the company.

Customer

ConnectWise is the world's leading software company dedicated to the success of IT solution providers. Their vision is to power a thriving IT ecosystem that transforms what's possible for SMBs and do this by empowering IT solution providers with unmatched software, services, and community to achieve their most ambitious vision of success. The tools being developed are used by IT service providers to automate their activities for small and medium sized businesses (SMBs), such as backup and restore, providing security, and performing administrative tasks on Microsoft 365 tenants.

Project

We are seeking an Executive Assistant to work alongside our VP of Engineering, driving data-driven decisions across engineering, product, operations, and related teams. In this role, you will not be responsible for executing or managing specific project delivery, but rather will build, maintain, and evolve the metrics, dashboards, analyses, and reporting infrastructure that inform leadership's strategic decisions.

Your core mission will be to provide high-visibility, actionable insights. You will coordinate with multiple teams to collect, validate, and interpret data; propose new KPIs and measurement strategies; identify trends, risks, and opportunities; and present your findings to Senior leadership or directly to the team on monthly business review meetings in a clear, compelling way.

You will act as a force multiplier, enabling the VP and Senior leadership to monitor progress, spot deviations early, and course-correct, while fostering alignment across stakeholders on how success is measured and communicated.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in a technical or data-oriented roles (e.g. analytics, reporting, technical product management, program management with a strong focus on metrics)
  • Strong experience working with cross-functional engineering, product, or operations teams
  • Experience analyzing large data sets, identifying trends and anomalies, and performing root cause analysis
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to simplify complex analyses into digestible narratives for Senior audiences
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with ability to influence across multiple teams without direct authority
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Experience in defining and refining KPIs, SLAs, OKRs, and similar measurement frameworks
  • Advanced level of English

Will be a plus

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, statistics, business analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience in technical domains (e.g. cloud, infrastructure, SaaS, and dev tools)
  • Familiarity with data warehouses, ETL processes, instrumentation, event tracking, observability, and monitoring systems
  • Experience working with program management tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, and Asana)
  • Prior experience reporting to Senior executives or being part of an executive-facing analytics and insights team
  • Prior experience with metrics governance (defining metric ownership, ensuring metric consistency, handling metric versioning, and maintaining metric catalogs)
  • Experience in tooling improvements for measurement (e.g. instrumenting new metrics, automating data collection, and adopting of data-quality tooling)

Personal Profile

  • High level of self-organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Structured work approach
  • Excellent communication skills

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain dashboards and scorecards to reflect the progress toward strategic objectives
  • Define, refine, and evolve KPIs, SLAs, OKRs, and other metrics frameworks in collaboration with engineering, product, operations, and business teams
  • Aggregate, cleanse, and correlate data from multiple systems (e.g. JIRA, monitoring, data warehouse, internal tools, and financial systems)
  • Analyze trends, variances, and anomalies. Perform root cause analyses, and propose actions or changes to processes or focus
  • Produce regular reports (weekly, monthly, quarterly) for the VP, the executive team, and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Partner with stakeholders to vet and align on metric definitions, reporting cadences, and data interpretations
  • Assist in setting targets, thresholds, and goals for key metrics, and monitor progress toward them
  • Monitor the health of metrics (data quality, signal stability, outlier detection, alerting) and drive remediation when issues arise
  • Identify gaps in current measurement capabilities; propose and drive enhancements, including new instrumentation, tooling, or process changes
  • Serve as the "go-to" analytics/metrics liaison between the VP and various teams (engineering, product, operations, finance)
  • Assist in preparing executive-level narratives and presentations, translating complex data into impactful stories
  • Stay abreast of industry best practices in metrics, observability, dashboards, and data analytics. Implement innovations and continuous improvements

title: NetSuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – Brazil

Salary: USD 1,700/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we're looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients' staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant's job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits/credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners' lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Consumer Communications Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

This is an on-site position, 5 days per week at Vila Olimpia.

About the Role:

Keeta is hiring a Consumer Communications Specialist to support the execution of our Press & KOL strategy in Brazil. You'll work with cross-funcional teams to implement campaigns, coordinate media and influencer activities, and ensure consistent messaging as we expand in the food delivery market. The ideal candidate is a collaborative executor with hands-on experience in media relations, KOL coordination, and campaign logistics.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Media & KOL Coordination: Assist in organizing interviews, press briefings, and influencer partnerships to secure positive coverage and amplify brand visibility.
  • Campaign Support: Help execute consumer-focused communications initiatives (e.g., press releases, product launches, events) to boost brand awareness and favorability.
  • Agency Collaboration: Work with PR agencies to track deliverables, manage timelines, and ensure alignment with Keeta's messaging.
  • Cross-functional Execution: Partner with Marketing, Social Media, and Government Affairs to implement integrated campaigns across all channels.
  • Crisis Support: Monitor media sentiment and assist in drafting responses to mitigate reputational risks.
  • Content & Reporting: Prepare media kits, track coverage, and generate reports on campaign performance (e.g., reach, tonality, share of voice).

Requirements:

  • Experience in consumer PR or communications experience, preferably in tech, food delivery, or related industries.
  • Proven ability to coordinate with journalists, KOLs, and agencies (traditional + social media).
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills to manage deadlines and stakeholders.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (written and spoken).
  • Familiarity with food/beverage or delivery sectors is a plus.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career. As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences. At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 30 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.

Sobre a vaga:

Estamos buscando Analista Fiscal Tributário Pleno para atuar de forma híbrida em São Paulo - SP.

-Horário: 9h-18h

-Modelo: Híbrido no escritório, sendo 2 vezes na semana presencial.

Atividades:

  • Apuração de PIS, COFINS, ISS e INSS sobre o faturamento (nacional e internacional);
  • Apuração e análise dos impostos retidos de terceiros, tanto nacionais quanto internacionais (importação);
  • Apuração e análise dos impostos em operações intercompany, incluindo o pagamento dos tributos e fechamentos de câmbio;
  • Envio das obrigações acessórias correspondentes e recolhimento dos impostos;
  • Conciliação contábil – fiscal das contas dos respectivos impostos;
  • Apoio à operação e gestão em questões relacionadas a impostos indiretos;
  • Participação em discussões sobre a Reforma Tributária;
  • Atendimento a auditorias internas e externas, bem como a eventuais fiscalizações e processos tributários;
  • Suporte em análises de planejamento tributário.

Requistos:

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Conhecimento em ERPs fiscais, preferencialmente Avalara;
  • Excel avançado.

Desejável:

title: Engenheiro de Dados (Inglês Fluente)
description:
#OPORTUNIDADES para Engenheiro de dados / BI Developer a níveis Pleno e Sênior !

Projeto Internacional | Remoto LATAM (Fuso Alemanha)

Detalhes do Contrato

  • Modelo: PJ via Deel
  • INGLÊS FLUENTE NECESSÁRIO
  • Local: 100% remoto (América Latina)
  • Fuso: Horário da Alemanha (CET) !
  • Contrato de longa duração

A Stefanini LATAM está em busca de Desenvolvedor BI / Engenheiro de Dados com INGLÊS FLUENTE para atuar em um projeto global no setor de saúde, com duração prevista até meados de 2026.

O contrato será no modelo PJ/contractor (via Deel) e a atuação é 100% remota, com alinhamento ao fuso horário da Alemanha (CET).

Buscamos profissionais na América Latina com sólida experiência em Dados e Business Intelligence, prontos para integrar um time técnico internacional de alta performance.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter soluções de BI utilizando Power BI, Tableau, SQL Server e Alteryx.
  • Colaborar com equipes de negócio globais para entender requisitos e transformá-los em dashboards e modelos de dados.
  • Otimizar processos de ETL e garantir a integridade e qualidade das informações.
  • Apoiar a migração de ETL legado para arquitetura AWS (prevista para 2026).
  • Integrar dados provenientes de SAP e outros sistemas corporativos.
  • Utilizar ferramentas Boomi para integração de dados.
  • Trabalhar em um POD técnico de 4 a 5 desenvolvedores, colaborando também com outras squads BI quando necessário.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados, Desenvolvedor(a) BI ou cargo equivalente.
  • Experiência com integração de dados SAP.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (para comunicação com times globais).
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no fuso horário CET (Alemanha).
  • Domínio de ferramentas: Power BI e Tableau; Alteryx; SQL Server; ETL; Plataforma Boomi; Talend; Databricks.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com serviços de dados em AWS.
  • Vivência em projetos do setor de saúde, medtech ou manufatura.
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis e times distribuídos internacionalmente.

VENHA SER STEFANINER!

title: Vendedor de varejo
description:
Vaga: VENDEDOR EXTERNO

Região de Atuação: SÃO PAULO/SP

Base Zona Oeste de São Paulo/SP

A HECKE ALIMENTOS, empresa brasileira que desde 2002 é especializada em distribuição de produtos argentinos (queijos, leite em pó, azeitonas, azeites e frutas secas) busca por profissionais de ALTA PERFORMANCE, com FOCO em resultados e DISCIPLINA na execução das estratégias comerciais.

Sua missão será fortalecer a presença dos nossos produtos no mercado, com EXCELÊNCIA e COMPROMETIMENTO, garantindo o sucesso em cada venda!

Se você é PERSISTENTE, PROATIVO e tem paixão por DESAFIOS, venha crescer conosco e alcançar grandes conquistas!

ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Atendimento a clientes de autosserviços, atacados e pequenos distribuidores;
  • Execução das estratégias comerciais no ponto de venda;
  • Negociação e venda de produtos conforme políticas e padrões da empresa;
  • Análise de metas, histórico e potencial dos clientes para planejamento de vendas eficazes;
  • Visitas conforme roteiro e planejamento diário;
  • Identificação de oportunidades de negócio e diagnóstico de perfis de clientes;
  • Estabelecimento de relacionamento de longo prazo com compradores;
  • Domínio do mix de produtos, políticas comerciais e campanhas vigentes.

PERFIL DESEJADO:

  • Comunicativo, proativo, com iniciativa, raciocínio lógico e visão estratégica;
  • Comprometido, com capacidade de planejamento, controle e relacionamento interpessoal.

REQUISITOS:

  • Formação: Ensino superior completo ou cursando.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos em vendas no varejo alimentar, food service ou distribuição de produtos alimentícios.
  • Habilidades: Conhecimento em técnicas de vendas no varejo, desenvolvimento de planos comerciais, conhecimento de merchandising, Microsoft Excel e facilidade com tecnologia.

OUTROS REQUISITOS:

  • Carteira ativa de clientes e bom relacionamento na região de atuação;
  • Habilidade de negociação e foco em resultados;
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para viagens.

CONDIÇÕES DE CONTRATAÇÃO:

  • Regime CLT;
  • Segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h às 18h;
  • Remuneração fixa compatível com o mercado + variável de até 50% sobre o salário fixo;
  • Benefícios: vale refeição, vale alimentação, reembolso por km rodado e plano de saúde coparticipação (após período de experiência: 90 dias).

COMO SE CANDIDATAR:

  • Envie seu currículo pelo LinkedIn Recruiter, incluindo sua pretensão salarial.

Junte-se à nossa equipe e faça a diferença!

title: Senior Cloud Engineer - Cloud Solutions Specialist (LATAM)
description:
Matilda Cloud is a pioneering force in cloud computing solutions, recognized globally for our innovative technology and premium service. Our mission is to empower businesses through transformative cloud solutions, enabling them to achieve unprecedented growth and efficiency.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer / Cloud Solutions Specialist with a strong technical background in cloud and DevOps practices, focused on the Latin American (LATAM) market. This role bridges technical expertise with client engagement—guiding customers to understand how Matilda Cloud's offerings solve their challenges.

The ideal candidate will be fluent in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, highly skilled in customer engagement, and comfortable translating complex technology into clear business value.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Communicate fluently in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, serving as the primary technical point of contact for LATAM clients.
  • Work alongside the sales team to gather customer requirements and devise effective technical strategies that address the specific needs of the LATAM market.
  • Partner with client IT and business teams to troubleshoot issues, remove roadblocks, and accelerate solution deployment.
  • Engage with partners to provide comprehensive training and enablement on Matilda Cloud solutions.
  • Collect customer feedback and relay insights to product and engineering teams to continuously improve offerings.
  • Support developers in containerizing applications and migrating them to Kubernetes.
  • Automate recurring tasks in container-based workflows into reusable CI/CD assets.
  • Design, build, manage and operate the infrastructure and configuration of container platforms with a focus on automation and infrastructure-as-cod
  • Manage Hybrid cloud enterprise Kubernetes clusters
  • Ensure reliable WFH readiness with stable high-bandwidth internet.
  • Travel across LATAM as needed for meetings and events.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's/master's in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud, DevOps, or technical sales engineering in LATAM.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux platforms.
  • Hands-on with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle Cloud).
  • Expertise in Kubernetes, container platforms, and hybrid cloud operations.
  • Proficiency in automation tools (Ansible, Helm, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Strong scripting background (Bash, Korn shell, PowerShell).
  • Exceptional communication and client-facing experience.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-changing environment.
  • Availability for regional travel.

Why Join Matilda Cloud?

Matilda Cloud offers a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits, and a vibrant, supportive work culture. We are dedicated to innovation and quality, providing our team with opportunities for professional growth and meaningful contributions to the cloud computing field.

Apply Now:

If you are passionate about leveraging your cloud technology expertise to drive engagements within the LATAM market and are fluent in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, we invite you to apply. Join Matilda Cloud to be at the forefront of delivering transformative cloud solutions across LATAM.

title: Talent Specialist
description:
Local: São Paulo, Brasil

Sobre a Posição (About the Role)

Como Especialista de Aquisição de Talentos, você será o ponto focal exclusivo para o recrutamento de ciclo completo no Brasil, atuando em um modelo estratégico de RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing). Você fará parceria com gerentes contratantes (Hiring Managers) de uma grande empresa farmacêutica para recrutar talentos cruciais, abrangendo desde o nível júnior até o de diretoria. Esta função é uma ponte vital entre coordenadores de contratação e recrutadores sêniores, garantindo a excelência do candidato e um impacto significativo no recrutamento.

Principais Responsabilidades (Key Responsibilities)

  • Recrutamento de ciclo completo para posições altamente especializadas e complexas no setor farmacêutico.
  • Propriedade e execução da contratação para funções de nicho, incluindo Clinical Research Associates (CRAs), Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs) e posições de liderança especializada.
  • Colaboração proativa com gerentes globais para posições com reporte internacional, exigindo forte comunicação para reuniões de alinhamento e intake meetings.
  • Melhorar a experiência do candidato, gerenciando todos os aspectos do engajamento, da logística à comunicação proativa.
  • Servir como o principal recrutador no Brasil, garantindo que as estratégias de sourcing e contratação sejam cultural e comercialmente relevantes.
  • Atuar como um parceiro consultivo para o cliente, oferecendo uma experiência de recrutamento profissional e de alto impacto.

Qualificações Obrigatórias (Required Qualifications)

  • 5+ anos de experiência em recrutamento de ciclo completo (full-cycle recruitment).
  • Capacidade comprovada de recrutar em uma ampla faixa de senioridade, do nível júnior ao de diretoria.
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês é mandatória.
  • Experiência como profissional de aquisição de talentos para uma empresa farmacêutica é altamente preferida.
  • Experiência em RPO ou em ambientes de contratação com múltiplos clientes é uma vantagem.
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais, de gestão de stakeholders e de comunicação, com adaptabilidade comprovada às demandas de contratação aceleradas.

Por Que Você Terá Sucesso (Why You'll Succeed)

  • Parceria Estratégica com o Cliente: Liderar uma experiência profissional "white-glove" (consultiva e de excelência) para um escritório sênior no Brasil.
  • Recrutamento de Nicho e Alto Impacto: Possuir a execução de ciclo completo e recrutar para funções complexas e de nicho que são críticas para o sucesso de uma grande farmacêutica.
  • Crescimento Profissional e Exposição Global: Expandir suas habilidades e sua rede ao operar dentro de um modelo RPO estratégico e multi-mercado, com exposição a vários países.
  • Conta Estabelecida: Juntar-se a uma conta de longa data que oferece um ambiente estável e de alto crescimento com investimento significativo.
  • Ambiente de Performance Claro: Trabalhar em uma equipe de alto desempenho com KPIs e SLAs definidos, permitindo que você veja o impacto direto do seu trabalho por meio da entrega rápida de shortlists e eficiência no time to fill.

Remuneração e Processo

  • Salário: Em Reais Brasileiros (CLT).
  • Atenção: O processo seletivo (entrevista) será conduzido integralmente em Inglês.

Talent Specialist

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

About the Role

As a Talent Specialist, you will be the single point of contact for full-cycle recruitment in Brazil within a strategic RPO model. You will partner with hiring managers at a major pharmaceutical company to recruit for mission-critical talent, from junior to director levels. This role is a vital bridge between hiring coordinators and senior recruiters, ensuring both candidate excellence and significant recruitment impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-end recruitment for highly specialized and complex roles within the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Ownership of hiring for niche roles, including Clinical Research Associates, Medical Science Liaisons, and specialized leadership.
  • Proactive collaboration with global managers for international-reporting positions, requiring strong communication for intake meetings and alignments.
  • Enhance the candidate experience, managing all aspects of engagement, from logistics to proactive communication.
  • Serve as the primary recruiter across Brazil, ensuring sourcing and hiring strategies are culturally and commercially relevant.
  • Act as a consultative partner for the client, providing a professional and impactful recruitment experience.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience.
  • Proven ability to recruit across a wide seniority range, from junior to director-level roles.
  • Fluency in both Portuguese and English is mandatory.
  • Background as a talent acquisition professional for a pharmaceutical company is highly preferred.
  • Experience in RPO or multi-client hiring environments is advantageous.
  • Strong organizational, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with proven adaptability to fast-paced hiring demands.

Why You'll Succeed

  • Strategic Client Partnership: Lead a white-glove professional experience for a senior office in Brazil.
  • High-Impact, Niche Recruiting: Own full-cycle execution and recruit for complex, niche roles that are critical to a major pharmaceutical company's success.
  • Professional Growth & Global Exposure: Expand your skills and network by operating within a strategic, multi-market RPO model with exposure across multiple countries.
  • Established Account: Join a long-standing account that offers a stable, high-growth environment with significant investment.
  • Clear Performance Environment: Work within a high-performance team that has clear KPIs and SLAs, allowing you to see the direct impact of your work through quick shortlist delivery and efficient time to fill.

Salary is in Brazilian Reais

title: Analista de contabilidade
description:
Descrição da Empresa: Pronto para trabalhar na empresa que é referência em soluções contábeis especializadas para o setor automotivo?

Atuamos com excelência técnica, transparência e inovação tecnológica, garantindo aos nossos clientes um serviço contábil completo e seguro.

Nosso propósito é simplificar a contabilidade e potencializar o crescimento sustentável das empresas.

Buscamos um(a) Analista Contábil Pleno I para integrar nosso time.

Objetivo do Cargo

Executar, revisar e analisar processos contábeis e fiscais de empresas enquadradas nos regimes Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional, garantindo a conformidade das demonstrações contábeis, o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a aderência às normas contábeis e fiscais vigentes..

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Realizar e revisar lançamentos contábeis, conciliações bancárias, de contas patrimoniais e de resultado.
  • Efetuar o fechamento contábil mensal.
  • Elaborar balancetes, demonstrações.
  • Garantir a correta classificação e contabilização de receitas, despesas, custos e provisões.
  • Apoiar na elaboração e revisão das ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital) e ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal).
  • Identificar inconsistências e propor ajustes contábeis e fiscais.
  • revisão e conciliação dos tributos apurados (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ISS).
  • Efetuar a conferência das obrigações acessórias fiscais com as contábeis.
  • Acompanhar alterações na legislação tributária e contábil.
Informações da vaga
  • Regime de contratação: CLT (efetivo)
  • Horário: Segunda a quinta das 8h às 18h, sexta das 8h às 17h (1h de almoço)
  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% presencial
  • Local: Rod. Washington Luiz, 2550, Parque Duque, Duque de Caxias – RJ (CEP )
Perfil ideal

Profissional detalhista, proativo(a), comprometido(a) com prazos e qualidade técnica, com facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e disposição para contribuir com a melhoria contínua dos processos contábeis.

Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills)

Essenciais para garantir precisão, cumprimento de prazos e qualidade nas entregas contábeis:

  • Fechamento contábil completo (mensal e anual);
  • Domínio das obrigações acessórias — ECD, ECF, DCTF e SPED Contábil;
  • Conciliação contábil e análise de contas patrimoniais e de resultado;
  • Apuração de impostos e classificação contábil correta;
  • Conhecimento sólido das normas contábeis (CPCs e NBCs);
  • Domínio em Excel (intermediário a avançado) — fórmulas, planilhas dinâmicas e relatórios;
  • Experiência com sistemas contábeis integrados (como Questor, Domínio, Alterdata, Prosoft ou similares);
  • Elaboração e interpretação de balanços e demonstrações financeiras;
  • Análise e conferência de documentos fiscais;
  • Atualização constante em legislação fiscal e tributária.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Data Solutions & Measurement
description:
Cint is a global software leader in technology-enabled digital insights and research technology. The Cint platform automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale. Cint has one of the world's largest consumer networks for digital survey-based research, made up of over 239 million engaged respondents across more than 130 countries. Over 4,600 insights-driven companies use Cint to accelerate how they gather consumer insights and supercharge business growth.
Job Description

The Team

The Cint Technology team is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our international Data Solutions & Measurement team. This position is for a software engineer who likes challenges. Our business has been doubling in the last few years and so our systems need to scale to accommodate this growth.

What You Will Do

Our ideal candidate considers themselves among the highly technical and likes to push the limits of their knowledge and experience every day. In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, scaling, and maintenance of the code that powers our production systems. You will work autonomously, providing technical direction and ensuring timely and high-quality delivery across multiple projects. You will proactively communicate and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product and Data Science, to drive strategic initiatives. With significant freedom to innovate, you will play a pivotal role in world-class research, shaping the next generation of Cint products and mentoring less experienced engineers.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years of hands-on professional backend software development experience, with a significant portion in a leadership or principal role.

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field.

  • Proficient programming skills in Python or Java and comfortable maintaining code in both languages, with a strong emphasis on architectural design and code quality.

  • Deep familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, advanced testing frameworks, and deployment strategies.

  • Extensive experience with complex API integration, design, and best practices, including defining API standards.

  • Expertise in dealing with system complexity, distributed systems, and large-scale architectural challenges.

  • Exceptional sense of ownership, accountability, and technical leadership.

  • Outstanding problem-solving, analytical, and strategic thinking skills.

  • Consistently questions the status quo and brings innovative, impactful solutions to engineering and product needs, driving significant technical advancements.

  • Strong ability to influence architecture and technical decisions across multiple teams, ensuring robust, scalable, and cost-efficient solutions that align with business objectives.

  • Enjoys working as part of a team, actively mentoring and guiding other engineers, and providing constructive feedback to foster growth.

  • Comfortable with making critical decisions based on comprehensive data analysis and industry best practices.

  • Outstanding communication skills to guide and facilitate complex cross-functional collaboration and present technical strategies to diverse audiences.

  • Extensive background in data analytics tools such as Spark, Hive, Databricks, or similar, with experience in designing and optimizing data pipelines.

  • Deep familiarity with observability strategies, including advanced monitoring, logging, and tracing.

  • Extensive experience with AWS, Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and advanced SQL, including database design and performance tuning.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We're pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We're accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We're open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other's experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We're proud to be recognised in Newsweek's 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world's largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

title: Business Analysis & Strategy Executive Partner
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: "We help people eat better, live better." Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Job Responsibilities:

1. Assist the business planning director in managing key global projects, including target planning and key task breakdown, coordinating internal and external resources, tracking project progress, and ensuring completion according to schedule.

2. Conduct research on the development landscape of the global food delivery and instant retail markets, gain insights into user needs, technological innovations, and competitive dynamics, and propose feasible strategic recommendations.

1. Bachelor's degree or above, with solid background in business analysis in the internet industry or strategic consulting in the consulting industry, and strong data analysis and industry research capabilities.

2. Familiar with and understand diverse cultures, excellent English skills, and able to use English as a working language.

3. Experienced in project management, with outstanding interpersonal communication and coordination skills, loyal to personal goals, and able to proactively and flexibly find ways to achieve objectives.

4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: High Ticket closer
description:
ABOUT US

Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE

We're hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you'll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline
  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion
  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach
  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions
  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1+ years of commission sales experience
  • Strong
  • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability
  • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses
  • Remote-friendly work environment
  • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development
  • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Gerente Executivo(a) Sustentabilidade e Meio Ambiente
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente Executivo(a) de Sustentabilidade e Meio Ambiente para integrar nosso time da Diretoria de Sustentabilidade, Novos Negócios e Relações Institucionais.

Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Liderar a estratégia e a gestão integrada de Sustentabilidade e Meio Ambiente da companhia, assegurando o cumprimento de requisitos legais e ambientais, a evolução da agenda ESG, a redução de riscos climáticos e ambientais, e a geração de valor sustentável para a empresa, seus stakeholders e a sociedade;
  • Liderar o plano de descarbonização da companhia, considerando o roadmap para atingimento de metas de redução de emissões alinhadas ao SBTi, incluindo análise de riscos físicos e de transição e identificação de soluções de baixo carbono;
  • Liderar a realização de inventários de emissões de GEE;
  • Coordenar os processos de certificações socioambientais (Bonsucro, Renovabio, SAI, CARB, EPA, SMETA, ISCC CORSIA, entre outros);
  • Coordenar a publicação do Relatório de Sustentabilidade, garantindo transparência e aderência a padrões internacionais;
  • Gerenciar, em coordenação com outras áreas da empresa, processos para o estabelecimento de uma cadeia de valor responsável e sustentável;
  • Assegurar a conformidade com requisitos legais, licenças e condicionantes ambientais;
  • Coordenar a implantação e evolução do Sistema de Gestão Ambiental, garantindo sua integração às operações agroindustriais, considerando gestão de resíduos, recursos hídricos, emissões atmosféricas, biodiversidade e outros potenciais impactos ambientais;
  • Implementar ações de reflorestamento e prevenção a incêndios;
  • Atuar na gestão de impactos, riscos e incidentes ambientais, incluindo identificação, controles operacionais, tratamento de incidentes e avaliações de abrangência;
  • Administrar a gestão de passivos ambientais;
  • Desenvolver, divulgar, avaliar e implantar, após previamente discutidas e analisadas, projetos e inovações técnicas em meio ambiente, objetivando minimizar os impactos no meio ambiente.

Quais os requisitos?

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento em normas e legislação ambiental;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em São José do Rio Preto/SP.

title: Engenheiro Eletricista
description:
OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL: Ser responsável pela investigação de eventos, em máquinas, equipamentos, dispositivos e/ou sistemas, onde tenham ocorridos danos e/ou falhas e fornecer um estudo de causa identificando o mecanismos ocasionador da falha, a extensão dos danos diretos e indiretos, a identificação e segregação dos danos/desgastes pré-existentes e/ou não relacionados, bem como recomendações técnicas a respeito dos reparos necessários e, sempre que possível, a apuração dos custos envolvidos. Também responsável por decidir o curso de ação mais adequado em investigações e realizar revisões de relatórios para processos que assim forem atribuídos e/ou demandados pela Diretoria.

FUNÇÕES ESSENCIAIS E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atribuir processos a engenheiros de acordo com sua área de responsabilidade e gerenciar o controle de qualidade e prazos de atendimento a regulação e Seguradoras.
  • Avaliar eventos nos mais diversos cenários, desde os residenciais, rurais até os industriais e fabris de grande porte.
  • Conduzir investigações para determinar e documentar o mecanismo de falha apresentando quando necessário como o dano surgiu e se propagou até a ocorrência da falha, a extensão dos danos e o escopo dos reparos necessários.
  • Investigar, avaliar e determinar a causa raiz da falha respaldando a regulação de toda a base técnica necessária para avaliar a cobertura dos eventos nas apólices e justificar perante as seguradoras e resseguradores. Sugerir mitigações para reduzir as perdas.
  • Desenvolver planos, relatórios e apresentações para atender as necessidades dos clientes e determinar e documentar o método de análise de falhas e investigação das causas.
  • Analisar os danos constatados, separando do escopo aqueles que não possuem vínculo direto com o evento ou que são devidos a outros eventos ou apenas ao desgaste natural pelo uso.
  • Colaborar com outros investigadores das demais áreas de conhecimento, quando o evento não afeta uma única disciplina e/ou equipamento. Inclusive em investigações de incêndio, alagamentos, desabamentos e outras catástrofes.
  • Atuar como testemunha especialista em tribunal e/ou em depoimentos.
  • Discutir com equipes técnicas de fabricantes, segurados e outros especialistas na validação e comprovação dos estudos e análises sempre que pertinente.
  • Documentar e manter horas faturáveis com base em tempo dispendido nas investigações e estudos inerentes ao processo a ser investigado.
  • Colaborar com a equipe comercial, gerentes operacionais, arquitetos, advogados, reguladores, gerentes de sinistros, diretoria e outros parceiros visando desenvolver o mercado e novas demandas pelos serviços da EFI Global do Brasil.
  • Colaborar com o restante da equipe de peritos da EFI para alavancar experiências e auxiliar em projetos.

FUNÇÕES ADICIONAIS E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Executar outras tarefas conforme designado.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens
  • Apoiar os programas de qualidade da organização.
  • Fazer uso das boas práticas de engenharia e das normas técnicas que forem aprlicáveis aos processos.

QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Desejável ter carteira de habilitação - B
  • Bacharelado de uma faculdade ou universidade credenciada pelo MEC.
  • Registro / Licença de Engenheiro Profissional (PE) pelo CREA, no mínimo, 4 anos.

EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Experiência mínima de 4 (quatro) anos, em indústria e/ou instalação de grande porte, realizando estudos de causa e análise de falhas, e gerenciamento de risco.

HABILIDADES E CONHECIMENTOS

  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita
  • Conhecimento em informática, incluindo produtos do Microsoft Office
  • Habilidades analíticas e interpretativas
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais
  • Excelentes habilidades interpessoais
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente ou em um ambiente de equipe
  • Capacidade de atender ou exceder as Competências de Desempenho

title: Analista de PPCM
description:
Sobre a vaga

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Gestão de planejamento de grandes paradas (anuais) e paradas mensais; rotinas programação semanal;
  • Acompanhar e controlar o plano de manutenção das linhas de produção, bem como realizar a programação de manutenções na Unidade Industrial;
  • Planejar as atividades da manutenção nas paradas programadas de fábrica, administrando a logística de materiais, ferramentas e serviços;
  • Indicar plano de ação e disponibilizar ferramentas e mão de obra, em casos de emergências, paradas de produção e/ou processo ou que impliquem em problemas nos aspectos de qualidade, segurança e meio ambiente;
  • Adequar os planos preventivos de equipamentos existentes, analisando as falhas repetitivas e elaborando planos de ação para melhorias, bem como contribuir com a de gestão de projetos de renovação dos mesmos;
  • Analisar criticamente os resultados das rotas de inspeção e manutenção preditiva, informando de maneira clara os riscos em termos de segurança associados à manutenção;
  • Controlar Back log e custos da linha de modo a manter o orçamento definido.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, tecnólogos em mecânica, mecatrônica, automação ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência na área de PPCM;
  • Conhecimento do sistema SAP módulo PM Manutenção;
  • Pacote office Intermediário;
  • Noções de mecânica, elétrica e instrumentação;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Jaguariaíva ou Arapoti.

title: Quality Control Analyst
description:
Working at Ruhrpumpen means being part of a team that values innovation, dynamism, and creativity. Join our team, experience making a difference and build your career!

As Quality Control Analyst you will guarantee and assure that company's products (hydraulic components and systems) and the materials used in manufacturing them meet the required standards, ensuring the highest levels of quality for customers.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Interpret test results, compare them to established specifications and control limits, and make recommendations on the appropriateness of data for release.
  • Conduct thorough inspections and tests on raw materials, in-process components, and finished products to ensure they meet predefined quality standards and specifications.
  • Collect and document data from quality tests, inspections, and audits, and maintain accurate records of quality control processes.
  • Perform visual inspections of finished products and provide assistance to production staff in terms of quality control procedures.
  • Identify and analyze any defects, discrepancies, or non-conformities in the finished products or processes, and collaborate with relevant teams to amend these issues.
  • Provide regular reports and updates to management and relevant stakeholders on the results of quality control tests.
  • Provide guidance to production and quality control staff on quality standards, testing procedures, and best practices to foster a culture of continuous improvement within the organization.
  • Lead the creation of quality documents within scope of customer projects (Industrial Pumps and Auxiliary Systems).
  • Lead plant's ISO audits and Customer Quality audits with support from corporate's quality team.
  • Unroll company ́s global Quality Managment System into Ruhrpumpen Jundiai plant.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor ́s degree in Engineering areas (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil)
  • Experience in Quality Assurance and/or Quality Control for Industrial plants in Brazil
  • Languages: Conversational English is a must, Spanish proficiency is desirable.
  • IT systems: Office Package & CAD viewing (drawings interpretation) necessary, PowerBI tools are desirable.

Descrição da vaga

Sobre a Empresa: A LL ANTUNES é uma Empresa de Engenharia, Manutenção Predial e serviços, especializada no atendimento B2B, com sede localizada no Rio de Janeiro. Atuando no mercado há mais de 10 anos, atendendo os principais players do varejo, lojas de departamento, indústrias e condomínios.

Missão do Cargo

Executar e acompanhar atividades técnicas em campo, garantindo o alinhamento entre projeto e execução, com foco na qualidade, produtividade e atendimento aos padrões da LL Antunes. Atuar de forma integrada com os times de engenharia, operações e clientes, contribuindo para entregas eficazes em obras, reformas, manutenções e serviços de engenharia civil.

Sobre a vaga:

1. Levantamento Técnico e Planejamento de Campo

- Realizar visitas técnicas para identificação de necessidades, levantamento de dados e diagnóstico de campo.

- Propor soluções técnicas viáveis e registrar informações para orçamentos e planejamento executivo.

2. Interpretação de Projetos e Documentação Técnica

- Interpretar plantas, memoriais descritivos e demais documentos técnicos.

- Garantir a execução conforme escopo contratado e diretrizes técnicas da empresa.

3. Acompanhamento de Equipes e Execução de Obras

- Acompanhar e coordenar obras civis, reformas e manutenções prediais do início à conclusão.

- Monitorar equipes CLT, empreiteiros e terceiros, assegurando produtividade, qualidade e cumprimento de prazos.

- Atuar como elo técnico entre escritório, campo e cliente, promovendo comunicação eficiente e alinhamento de informações.

4. Suporte Técnico e Resolução de Demandas

- Dar suporte técnico às equipes em campo, solucionando dúvidas e contribuindo para a correta execução das atividades.

- Atuar como referência técnica em demandas operacionais recorrentes.

5. Controle Operacional e Relatórios de Campo

- Preencher e atualizar planilhas, checklists e bancos de dados técnicos e administrativos.

- Garantir rastreabilidade das atividades e apoiar a tomada de decisão da gestão de operações.

6. Planejamento e Organização da Rotina:

- Estruturar e acompanhar o cronograma das atividades de campo (diárias, semanais e mensais).

- Cumprir a programação com foco em eficiência, produtividade e prazos acordados com os clientes.

7. Relacionamento e Postura Profissional:

- Manter postura cordial e profissional em campo, especialmente em contato com clientes, lojistas e parceiros.

- Fornece feedbacks contínuos sobre o andamento dos serviços, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas com o cliente e a equipe interna.

8. Conhecimento Técnico Aplicado:

- Aplicar conhecimentos práticos em obras civis e sistemas prediais (hidráulica, elétrica, alvenaria, pintura, drywall, estrutura metálica, etc.).

- Zelar pelo cumprimento dos SLAs e padrões técnicos da LL Antunes, com atenção aos detalhes e responsabilidade nas entregas.

description:

title: Corporate Communications Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

This is an on-site position, 5 days per week at Vila Olimpia.

About the Role:

Keeta is looking for a Corporate Communications Exper to support the execution of our external communications strategy in Brazil. You will work with media, PR agencies, and cross-functional teams to implement campaigns, manage media relations, and maintain brand consistency in a fast-paced tech environment. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented executor with strong organizational skills and experience in media engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Campaign Execution: Support the rollout of integrated communications initiatives (press releases, media pitches, events) to enhance brand visibility and positive media coverage.
  • Media & KOL Coordination: Assist in managing relationships with journalists and influencers, including scheduling interviews, sharing updates, and tracking coverage.
  • Agency Support: Work with external PR agencies to coordinate deliverables, ensuring alignment with Keeta's messaging and deadlines.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Marketing, Social Media, Government Affairs, and Internal Comms to implement consistent messaging across channels.
  • Crisis Response: Help monitor and address reputational risks, including drafting holding statements and supporting rapid response efforts.
  • Content & Reporting: Prepare press materials, media lists, and performance reports (e.g., coverage metrics, sentiment analysis).

Requirements:

  • Experience in corporate communications or PR experience, preferably in tech, food delivery, or related sectors.
  • Experience supporting media campaigns, agency coordination, and crisis comms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication in Portuguese and English.
  • Organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Familiarity with food/beverage or delivery industries is a plus.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career. As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences. At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 30 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond. Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
ompany Overview:

Anker Innovations is a global leader in charging technology and a developer of consumer electronics and smart devices. We are committed to bringing innovative products to our customers and ensuring the highest standards of quality and service. As we expand our presence in Latam, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Channel Specialist to join our team

Key Responsibilities:

As a Channel Specialist, you will be the cornerstone of our channel expansion and management efforts in Brazil. Your core duties will include:

This includes facilitating orders, managing procurement processes, monitoring sales targets, and ultimately being accountable for the sales performance and revenue growth within your channel.

Qualifications:

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven professional with:

  • Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in both Portuguese and English is mandatory.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of relevant experience in sales, channel management, or key account management.
  • Industry Knowledge: Prior experience in the consumer electronics industry is highly preferred.
  • Cultural Affinity: Experience working with or for a Chinese company is a significant advantage.
  • Personal Attributes: A self-starter with a strong sense of initiative, excellent resilience under pressure, and a genuine enthusiasm for embracing change and challenges. You must be a quick learner who can rapidly apply new knowledge to your work.

  • A pivotal role in the expansion of a globally recognized and beloved brand.
  • A dynamic, fast-paced, and supportive international work environment.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:

Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Entusiasmo: Acreditamos que o entusiasmo e a positividade são essenciais para o sucesso. Quem ama o que faz trabalha com alegria e aproveita a jornada.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.

Estamos procurando profissionais dinâmicos e proativos, com uma atitude positiva e habilidades em negócios e sistemas para trabalho em equipe. Valorizamos paciência, comprometimento e a capacidade de lidar bem com usuários e clientes.

title: General Counsel - Brazil
description:
1. Role Overview

The General Counsel will serve as the primary legal advisor to the company's Brazilian operations. This role will provide strategic legal guidance on all aspects of the business — including regulatory, corporate, labor, competition/antitrust, consumer, commercial, compliance, and litigation — to enable the successful launch and sustainable growth of the company's food delivery platform in Brazil.

The GC will be part of the local leadership team and act as a trusted partner to the Country General Manager, ensuring that business strategies align with Brazilian law and global corporate governance standards.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic & Advisory

  • Act as a key legal advisor to senior management on all strategic initiatives, expansion plans, and business partnerships in Brazil.
  • Structure and negotiate high-value commercial contracts (restaurant, courier, and supplier agreements).
  • Support the setup of local corporate entities and governance structures.
  • Manage regulatory and legislative engagement with relevant authorities.

Regulatory & Competition Law

  • Advise on competition compliance with Brazilian competition/antitrust laws (Law 12.529/2011).
  • Manage potential CADE filings, investigations, or commitments (TCCs).
  • Manage potential court litigation of compeition law issue.
  • Monitor digital-platform and consumer-protection regulations affecting food delivery services.

Operational Legal Support

  • Manage draft, review, and negotiate agreements with restaurants, delivery partners, payment providers, and marketing agencies.
  • Advise on employment and contractor classification, data privacy (LGPD), and consumer law matters.
  • Support the launch of new products and services (e.g., grocery delivery, fintech, logistics).

Litigation & Dispute Management

  • Oversee and coordinate external law firms handling litigation, consumer actions, and regulatory disputes.
  • Establish internal processes for dispute resolution, pre-litigation negotiation, and cost control.

Compliance & Ethics

  • Develop and implement compliance programs consistent with Brazilian and global standards (anti-corruption, data protection, competition).
  • Conduct training for employees and management on key compliance topics.

Team Leadership

  • Build and manage a local legal team.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree above in Law or a related legal field from an accredited institution, possess an active Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) license, and demonstrate extensive expertise in corporate law, commercial transactions, with a proven track record in navigating complex legal landscapes.
  • Over 10 years working experience , demonstrate deep mastery of legal strategy and legal frameworks ,including labor regulations, consumer protection laws, data privacy and antitrust legislation; ability to identify anticompetitive practices, assess regulatory scrutiny risks, and contribute to strategic planning to ensure market compliance.
  • Strong capability to manage litigation, arbitration, law enforcement investigation and CADE matter.
  • Proficient in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating diverse legal documents, such as merchant partnership agreements, delivery rider contracts, platform terms of service, and dispute resolution clauses.
  • Skilled in providing strategic legal counsel to senior management, anticipating potential legal risks, and developing robust compliance programs tailored to Brazil's dynamic regulatory environment.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration abilities, with experience working alongside operations, finance, and HR teams to align legal strategies with business goals and operational efficiency.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.Prior experience in the tech, logistics, or food delivery sector, e-commerce,particularly with scaling operations in Brazil, is highly desirable.

title: Rider Growth Trainee
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: "We help people eat better, live better." Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Job Responsibilities

  • Support the full recruitment journey for new riders, from attracting leads to making sure they're ready to start, always following company standards.
  • Help test and compare different ads and landing pages (A/B tests) to find the best ways to attract new riders.
  • Use data to share clear insights with the team about market trends, competitor activities, and where the recruitment process can improve.
  • Assist in building and improving communication channels with riders, ensuring they feel supported throughout the process.
  • Collaborate with operations, marketing, and product teams to align strategies that improve rider growth.

Requirements:

  • This position is open to graduates whose graduation dates fall between November 2025 and October 2026.
  • Good English communication for the daily work and contact with foreign team.
  • A creative mindset for problem-solving and adapting strategies to dynamic markets.

title: Agente de Negócios - Representante Comercial PJ | Açu - RN
description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time

Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia, referência na América Latina. Com soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente, com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Contamos com o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios e o iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre na vanguarda, com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário

Nesta posição, você será o ponto de conexão entre o iFood e novos parceiros de negócios. Seu dia a dia será guiado por estratégias de expansão, conquistando novos clientes em áreas com grande potencial de crescimento.

Entre as principais responsabilidades, você irá:

  • Prospecção de novos parceiros: Identificar oportunidades de mercado e atrair restaurantes e estabelecimentos para o ecossistema iFood.
  • Gestão de funil de vendas: Realizar acompanhamento detalhado do pipeline, assegurando a conversão em cada etapa.
  • Acompanhamento contínuo: Manter contatos regulares e estruturados com potenciais clientes para estreitar relacionamentos.
  • Gestão de relacionamento: Ser referência no atendimento às demandas dos parceiros, garantindo uma experiência incrível desde o início.
  • Colaboração estratégica: Trabalhar de forma integrada com o time para maximizar resultados e impulsionar a presença do iFood na cidade de Açu - RN.

Ingredientes que Buscamos

  • Experiência em vendas: Um diferencial será ter atuado com vendas externas, prospecção ou gestão de carteira.
  • Comunicação excepcional: Habilidade oral e escrita para interações via telefone, WhatsApp e e-mail.
  • Perfil organizado e resiliente: Energia, senso de dono e capacidade de se adaptar a um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Habilidade de negociação e persuasão: Capacidade de argumentar e buscar resultados acima da média, sempre com foco no cliente.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal: Facilidade em criar conexões significativas e construir parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Morar na cidade e ter como se locomover: Ser residente da cidade de Açu - RN e possuir mobilidade para realizar deslocamentos com facilidade.

Sobre Nós

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e alcançar #Resultados incríveis. Por isso, valorizamos candidatos independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde as pessoas escolham se desenvolver e realizar seus sonhos. #AllTogether.

Conheça nossas iniciativas | Institucional iFood

Você Tem Fome de Quê?

Temos fome de inovação e resultados. Sempre buscamos fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e agindo com agilidade e responsabilidade. Valorizamos a diversidade, o conhecimento e o compartilhamento em um ambiente dinâmico e versátil. O ingrediente especial da nossa receita? As pessoas. Vem fazer parte disso!
